title: CD3 / Our Future Health (schemify pilot) — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable. Shared across both tables in this package (participant, questionnaire).

prefer_not_to_answer.title: Prefer not to answer
prefer_not_to_answer.description: Adopted verbatim from the source's own coding tables (our_future_health_codings_v14.xlsx). Confirmed invariant at scale: appears with this exact meaning across all 5 DEMOG_* participant-domain fields and 347 of 353 coded questionnaire-domain fields.

suppressed.title: Suppressed
suppressed.description: Adopted verbatim from the source's own coding tables: statistical disclosure control, not a generic 'missing' sentinel. Note this is a DIFFERENT meaning from the -999 used in the sibling BGS pilot package (that one is agent-decided generic missingness) -- packages are independent and this collision is expected, not a bug.

dont_know.title: Do not know
dont_know.description: Adopted verbatim from the source's own coding tables. Found only in the questionnaire domain (280 of 353 coded fields), not present in participant.

none_of_the_above.title: None of the above
none_of_the_above.description: Adopted verbatim from the source's own coding tables (131 of 353 coded questionnaire fields). Unlike the other three shared defs, this is a substantive response (the participant actively selected 'none of the listed options apply'), not a missingness sentinel -- centralised here because the code and meaning are invariant wherever it appears, per SCHEMA-PATTERNS.md's rule for any truly invariant shared shape, not only sentinels.
